articles.title: Earth’s Gravity Redirects Juice Toward Jupiter
articles.summary: Juice’s September 28 Earth flyby increased its speed by 3.5 kilometers per second while saving fuel. Mission teams also used the encounter to calibrate instruments for future observations at Jupiter.

articles.title: California Fault Model Explores a Changing ‘Earthquake Gate’
articles.summary: A 1,000-year simulation suggests unusually high stress in parts of two Southern California fault systems. It also explores how conditions at Cajon Pass can influence whether a rupture crosses between them.

articles.title: Manatees and Sand Tiger Sharks Use Gas to Stay Afloat
articles.summary: Gas is more than a digestive byproduct for some aquatic animals. Manatees can adjust gas in their guts, and sand tiger sharks swallow air that helps them hover underwater.
